scope: 24 selected clips, both eyes, central 90 frames of the released renders; each representation against its own source

config.interval: central 90 frames of the frozen 270-frame interval
config.input: released HEVC decoded to yuv420p10le, no conversion
config.metric: Y' BT.709 pooled-MSE PSNR and Gaussian SSIM (11x11, sigma 1.5) in nine 1536x1536 viewports, Lanczos4
config.mask: geometrically valid in both representations and luma > 1/1023 in both sources, eroded 11x11
